displayPattern: Shown on the control board 7-segment display: EE2 (induced draft blower runs, furnace does not light)
meaning: Pressure switch circuit is not closed.
causes: Pressure switch hose blocked, pinched or connected improperly
Blocked flue and/or inlet air pipe
Incorrect pressure switch set point or malfunctioning switch contacts
diySteps: Check the outdoor flue and intake terminations for blockage (snow, debris, nests)
Technician: inspect the pressure switch hose and repair or replace if necessary
Technician: inspect flue/inlet piping length, elbows and termination
Technician: check induced draft blower performance and pressure switch operation
Technician: tighten or correct wiring connections
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the vent terminations are clear and the code persists.
